column1: # TXV-GUN verdicts (9 Oct 2026, verifier session separate from the TX-POOL-LEAF builder; PREREG-txeng2-9 V3; LANE TX-ENGINEER-2): the 15 positions build_gunther8246p2.py flagged align-conflict. Decided from the WVO 8246 MS p.2 scan line crops (txpool/gunther8246-p2/crops/), the Japikse 1934 no.316 print (japikse_p343-344_spaced.txt), the whole-letter alignment (align_letter.tsv) and the 5109-rebuilt key (key.tsv, pairs_5109.tsv). passA/passB/passZ not opened. Applied by benchmark-tx/build_gunther8246p2.py as build_birago152.py applies its flags: FLAG writes `class` to the flag column (truth unchanged; tx_bench --exclude-flagged drops it); CORRECT re-forces correct_plain through the key (plus add_signs) and writes `corrected:<class>` (still scored); KEEP clears the flag.

column8: the sign is the d-shaped theta (bar running well out both sides, as th=d at p2L21.1, p2L17.4); the print has the abbreviation "E.L." here, which this letter enciphers elsewhere by the single code Ol alone (p2L21.15, p3L05.1, p3L15.7, p3L18.13); th before Ol recurs only at p1L10.10, where it aligns to nothing; no print letter is forced on this sign

the aligner gave the final n of "Königlichen" to 34 because 4000 was primed as one letter; 4000 is the word code for "Königliche(n)" and "Wüfden"/Würden follows as 34 60 44 88x th f or, w written with two u-class signs as at p1L07 (4000 34 44 60 88 tau f ps = Würden); 34 = u 25 times in this letter, never n; the image shows a plain 34

the print's "Wüfden" (left verbatim by the builder) is a misprint for Würden (Königlichen Würden at p1L07 and throughout the edition); 88x = r 21 of 22 times in this letter and in the 5109 key; the image shows the barred 88 as at p2L06.7 (r)

diessen: the sign is a short I with flat bars top and bottom and no middle stroke; the o-valued Ib (5109 exemplar n=1; p2L03.8, p2L14.12 on this letter) is a tall I crossed through the middle; the label Ib lumps the two (three with the overlined form at p2L24.12)
fortzusetzen: the sign is an x with a dot on each side; the a-valued x (5109 n=3; p2L17.3, p2L12.7) is undotted; the label x lumps the dotted form, which carries f here and at p2L17.13

fortzusetzen: 12 signs on 12 letters, so the alignment is sure and the print's o is sure; the sign is an or (= n, 13 times in this letter) under a heavy ink blot, possibly a blotted correction by the encipherer; the image cannot show what was meant
So hab ich: the same short flat-barred I as p2L08.17 (s), not the middle-crossed o-form the key's Ib exemplar carries

ich: d6 carries c at all 6 occurrences in this letter (p1L04.16, p1L07.14, p2L12.5, p2L22.11, p3L04.11, p3L11.13), each print-sure; the key's d6 = d rests on 2 passage-initial 5109 pairs ("der von Egmont", A1.1, P1.1); either the 5109 glyph is a different form or the value changed between the letters; the 5109 exemplar was not located on its scan within this pass, so the shape difference is not shown, only the value split

Lothringen: the sign is a round O-with-bar whose bar stays inside the oval; the d-valued th (5109 n=2; 31 times d here, e.g. p2L08.13, p2L17.4, p2L21.1, p2L24.11) is a narrower theta whose bar runs out both sides; the label th lumps the two
iascheftig: the dotted x (a dot each side), as p2L11.1; the plain x two signs earlier in the same line (p2L17.3) is undotted and = a
mögen: the round O-with-inner-bar, as p2L15.12, not the d-theta

E.L. woll: Ol is the E.L. code (see p2_L05.14) and "woll" is 34 60 th m of, w written with two u-class signs as in Würden (p2_L06.9); the aligner spread the E.L. letters onto Ol (e) and 34 (l); 34 = u, plain 34 on the image
woll: the round O-with-inner-bar, as p2L15.12 and p2L21.11
betrachten: d6 = c, as p2_L12.5 (6 of 6 in this letter)
diesser: the sign is a flat-barred I under an overline, a third form beside the middle-crossed o-Ib and the plain flat-barred s-Ib; i also at p3L05.15 and p3L16.7 under the same label
